Shopify Admin API vs Storefront API

Admin API supports authorized merchant operations; Storefront API supports customer-facing
commerce. Use the appropriate token type and minimal scopes; never expose privileged Admin
credentials.
Admin API එක store management වුඩ සඳහායි. Storefront API එක customer-facing catalog/
cart වුඩ සඳහායි. Admin access token එක public කරන්න එපා.

Real-world example
A backend updates products while a storefront reads a public catalog.
